$comment: Schema for rows in the evidence table. Every ring entry MUST have a source_url. The audit script will fail if a ring row has no source_url. New fields added in v2: width_mm, weight_g_total, weight_g_gold, stone_carats_white, stone_carats_yellow, stone_carats, stone_ctw, center_stone_ct, stone_range_ctw, stone_type, stone_sku, original_price_usd, discount_pct, price_usd_from, price_usd_to, setting_only.

rules.no_hallucination: If you did not read a number on the source page, leave the field null or omit it. Do not estimate.
rules.weight_g: Use weight_g when the seller reports the whole-ring weight. Use weight_g_total + weight_g_gold if the seller reports both (e.g. The Karat Store).
rules.price_usd: Use price_usd for a single listed price. Use price_usd_from if the price varies (e.g. Tiffany 'starting from' pricing).
rules.setting_only: Set to true if the price is for the setting only and the center stone is sold separately.
